title: Demo of the Player
summary: For the tests and the window probe: clips, an image, one not recorded, a shared set, enough text to scroll.

steps.title: A step's own media
text: The first clip counts frames: 240 of them, 24 a second, a color each.
The second is the same clip again, its paragraph this one, held on its last frame at its end. Breadcrumbs read like this: Properties > Modifiers > Kneady > Speed.
The third is not recorded, so the panel says so in its place, with a button to watch it online.

The fourth is an image, held for its seconds before the next. A paragraph long enough to scroll: the wheel over the text scrolls it, and Follow Video brings each item's paragraph back into view as it changes.

steps.title: No media
text: A step with text alone: no clip, no controls under it.

steps.title: The shared set
text: This step has no media of its own, so it shows the tutorial's shared set.
Its second item lights this paragraph.

steps.title: The shared set, still playing
text: Coming here from the step before, the shared clip plays on where it was.
